ValidationRule.description: Whenever HR Approves check CPR Expiry < Today for Credit Card, Credit Limit Increase & Cash Collateral Application
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_HR_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_HR_Result__c, "Approved"), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), cc_CPR_Expiry_Date__c < TODAY(), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Card Cash Collateral Application") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: CPR Expiry date must be greater than today's date. Please request an updated CPR from the staff.
